scope: All six teams in the three 2026-10-20 NBA opening day games. Wide discovery; deeper analyses limited to evidence-bearing cases.

schedule.matchup: Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs

data_cautions: All reference player lines/odds are from an October 15 reported snapshot and stale for October 20 execution.
Lines without a reference are explicitly hypothetical research thresholds; alternate-line market availability unverified.
No sound independent player probability distribution, joint model, de-vigged executable market, or settled performance grading has been computed.
Player active status and confirmed lineups to be rechecked close to tipoff; media projections are not official final confirmations.
2026 finals return and ring ceremony describe motivation/narrative, not numeric edge.
All prior season averages require role/roster adjustment; season opener has uncertainty.
A pregame research nomination is not proof of positive expected value.

builds.type: Pistons same-game Cade 10+ assists plus Duren 10+ rebounds

Cross-game outcomes structurally distinct; independent prices/forecast calibration still missing
Hype-based grouping without independently qualified legs or payout

hypotheses.question: Does high narrative intensity on banner night or Finals rematch improve forecast relative to stable-minute baseline?
hypotheses.control: Predict from role-minutes and usage without narrative modifier
hypotheses.criterion: Paired Brier/log loss if valid frozen probabilities exist; otherwise outcome-only no calibration score

hypotheses.question: Does adding newly acquired high-usage teammates reduce historical points-plus-assists projections for Maxey/Brown/George?
hypotheses.criterion: Same player/event snapshots and minutes-adjusted opportunities

hypotheses.question: Do doubles involving player scoring plus creator assists exhibit positive dependence after conditioning on game state?
hypotheses.criterion: Four-cell joint settlement and priced payout vs independent joint model

required_for_final_gate: actual executable DraftKings quote and timestamp
